title: BACGene Protocol for Listeria Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired parameters in the Opentrons App (e.g., up to 96 target samples for Listeria and/or Salmonella); the system will automatically prepare lysis buffer with enzyme addition as needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the .py protocol script.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place all labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT‑2 App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button to start the protocol execution.
